title: Deterministic contradiction-scan pass: first producer of contradicts edges
description: The contradiction query (qt_contradiction_query) reads contradicts edges honestly-empty forever — nothing writes them. Ship a deterministic contradiction-scan pass (the deferred ex_reflection/contradiction-producer arc) as the first producer: a budget-bounded pass over staged+active claims, mirroring the run_er_pass shape (bajan-9pm's candidate pre-filtering applies). Deterministic detection scope, red-first: pairs whose normalized texts share a subject anchor (e.g. same leading noun phrase / same normalized subject key) and are incompatible by a closed rule set — negation pair ('X is Y' vs 'X is not Y' / 'no X' vs 'X'), and numeric mismatch (same subject, same unit, different number). Every proposed pair is written as a contradicts edge (insert_edge, gm_relation_typing vocabulary) tagged with the pass identity + rule in the edge metadata/provenance; report mirrors ErReport (status/proposed/refused/pairs) with honest exhaustion. DESIGN DECISION TO MAKE IN-TICKET: whether contradicts edges land directly (graph-structure-only per qt_contradiction_query, like ER's possible_duplicate_of) or route through a HITL queue first — ER has er_human_resolution; contradicts edges have no resolution path specced. Prefer: land edges directly but carry producer provenance, and note the HITL question as a follow-up ticket rather than blocking. SPEC: likely needs one new invariant (contradicts-edge provenance: only the deterministic scan writes contradicts edges in-pipeline) added to specs/graph-model.md or a small reflection section — spk lint/graph/compile must stay clean; regenerate artifacts. ACCEPTANCE: (1) red-first tests — negation pair proposes, numeric mismatch proposes, unrelated pairs do not, budget exhaustion honest, determinism (same store twice → same edges, dedupe refuses re-insert per edge-set discipline); (2) scale: the scan completes at 2k claims within a modest budget (reuse the bajan-9pm blocking lesson); (3) CLI: bajan contradict-scan --budget; (4) full suite green, spk lint 0, ah check clean after any contract additions. ANTI-GOALS: no LLM in this pass (deterministic only per gm_deterministic_er spirit); no adjudication/verdict fields (qt_contradiction_query reports structure only); no mutation of claim statuses. METER: cargo test --locked --release (all green) && spk lint specs (0) && spk graph specs && ah check --run-tests.
notes: issue-review (f83d37e): (1) PIN the subject-anchor definition — 'same leading noun phrase' is not deterministic; preferred tighter formulation: candidate pairs = normalized texts identical except a closed edit class (negation marker present/absent, or a differing numeral token) — this removes fuzzy subject detection entirely and is red-first-able. (2) SCOPE NOTE the store change: insert_edge(from,label,to) carries NO provenance today (edges table is a bare triple) — 'tagged with pass identity + rule' requires an edges-table column + ExtractionDump field + dump-recreate durability per gm_embedded_store; add that to acceptance explicitly. (3) if the scan lands in a NEW module (review.rs is ER), add the file to metadata.files and carry the Purpose/Responsibilities/Rationale header criterion. (4) espectacular gotcha: ah scenario new REFUSES post-archive — new contracts for the provenance invariant must be hand-authored matching the generated schema.

title: pdf2bajan: whole-book-empty extraction exits 0 with empty stream — silent-empty failure class
description: SMOKE EVIDENCE (real-doc run, ~/Downloads/fpa): 'Mike Piper - Accounting Made Simple (2010)' PDF (595KB, text-rich — pdftotext extracts full prose) -> pdf2bajan exits 0 with an EMPTY episode stream. title: er pass: pair walk is O(n^2) with per-comparison budget — book-scale stores can never complete
description: SMOKE EVIDENCE: one real EPUB (Profit First, 50 episodes) through the default atomizer -> 4815 staged claims. run_er_pass (src/review.rs) walks ALL pairs (n*(n-1)/2 ~ 11.6M comparisons), counts each comparison against the shared budget (qt_bounded_traversal), and recomputes normalize() for BOTH sides inside the inner loop (quadratic recompute on top). Result: er --budget 20000/50000/100000 all report budget-exhausted with 0 pairs — honest per spec, but the pass is unusable at book scale and the only signal is a number users must guess. FIX SHAPE (red->green, keep honest-exhaustion semantics): (1) precompute normalize per hit once (O(n)); (2) pre-filter candidate pairs before counting (length-bucket or prefix-group so normalization-equal/contains candidates are cheap to enumerate — containment still needs the candidate set, not all pairs); (3) consider budgeting CANDIDATE comparisons, not all-pairs comparisons, with the status still distinguishing 'no candidates' (complete) from 'candidates remained unseen' (exhausted). Keep the existing tests green; add a scale regression test (e.g. 2k claims, modest budget, completes) — likely needs the in-memory store.

title: converters: HTML li/blockquote text concatenates without separators
description:

Fix: treat block container elements (li, blockquote, div, td) as paragraph boundaries — flush before/after, or recurse as their own paragraph scope so each li becomes its own blank-line-joined paragraph. Decide and document the mapping (one episode per heading segment, paragraphs = block elements) and add regression tests for ul/ol/blockquote/table.

or block containers. Regression tests: ul/ol/blockquote/table/dl boundaries, blockquote multi-paragraph split. Gates: converters 21 tests, clippy -D 0, fmt clean; E2E 'Alpha Beta Done.' verified through ingest all-persisted; bajan 118 untouched; Cargo.toml diff empty.

title: converters: episode ids not stream-unique (case-slug + disambiguator collisions)
description: Per RO5U review of converters/ (bajan-quq follow-up), CORR-001 TypeSafe-verified (0.93). collect() (converters/src/lib.rs:118-132) keys the disambiguation counter on the RAW anchor while segment_id() derives the slug from the LOWERCASED anchor, so two failure classes produce duplicate ids within one stream: (a) anchors differing only by case ('# Notes' then '# notes' -> both id 'notes'); (b) heading text that collides with another anchor's disambiguator ('# Notes', '# Notes', '# Notes 2' -> 'notes-2' twice). Duplicate ids in one stream make bajan ingest reject the later record (ic_batch_duplicate) — the converter emits records bajan must reject, contradicting the stated invariant in segment_id's doc comment. Empirical probes confirmed both (X dupes: 1, Y dupes: 1). Fix: key the seen-counter on the DERIVED slug (run segment_id's slug derivation, then count), so disambiguation is per-final-id. Regression tests: case-variant anchors, disambiguator-text collisions, plus a stream-uniqueness assertion over a proptest corpus of headings.

Regression: 3 scenario tests (md case-variants, md disambiguator mimic, html case-variants+lookalike in one doc) + p_stream_ids_unique proptest over 10 collision-prone anchor words x levels 1-6 (0..20 headings, pairwise-distinct asserted). title: deps: pin deterministic NLP/IR crates for post-pass + evidence-span tooling
description:
Pin the deterministic NLP/IR crates for bajan's post-persist passes and
converter tooling. Source: investigation of 2026-09-29 (Rule-of-5 reviewed,
verdict READY-WITH-NOTES; corrections below are incorporated).

Grounding: knowledge-graphs-report.md "deterministic-first pipeline"
(avoid LLMs wherever traditional IR/NLP works; Chalef simhash/entropy
dedup; Blumenfeld idempotent structural loading) + specs/ingestion-contract.md
(ic_no_format_parsing, ic_id_canon) + specs/extraction-claims.md
(ex_no_llm_post, ex_deterministic_structure, ex_reflection) +
openspec/changes/update-extraction-provenance (ex_evidence_containment, D3).

## Crates — inside bajan (post-persist, format-free; ic_no_format_parsing applies)

| Task (spec anchor) | Default pick | Fallback |
|---|---|---|
| NFC id canonicalization (ic_id_canon) | `unicode-normalization` | none needed — Unicode std algo |
| Sentence boundary detection — alignment aid for extractor + reflection flag pass, NOT the gate (ex_reflection; design.md D3 unknown-span path) | `unicode-segmentation` (UAX #29, script-neutral) | `pragmatic-segmenter` (verify maintenance + English bias) or UAX #29 + small custom abbreviation table |
| Chunk assembly for the single extraction call (ex_single_call) | `text-splitter` (tiktoken mode optional) | hand-rolled split on UAX #29 sentence bounds |
| Token budget counting | `tiktoken-rs` | estimate via chars/4 for dev builds |
| Simhash/entropy dedup (ex_no_llm_post) | `simhash` crate (verify quality among same-named crates) | hand-rolled 64-bit char-n-gram simhash (~50 lines); entropy inline |
| Whitespace-collapsed containment check (ex_evidence_containment, lands via bajan-0hs.3) | `aho-corasick` or `memchr` | std substring search |

## Crates — upstream converters only (conform to episode-stream schema; NEVER bajan deps)

- Markdown: `comrak` or `pulldown-cmark` (headings/links → locators + structure markers)
- HTML: `html5ever`/`scraper`
- EPUB: `epub` crate
- PDF: `pdf-extract` or poppler `pdftotext` — weakest deterministic link; bounded by verbatim-persistence + locator-absent-marker contract

## Design note (CORR-001, HIGH): chunking vs ex_single_call

specs/extraction-claims.md:40 mandates exactly one successful LLM
extraction call per (episode id, extractor version). Chunking is input
ASSEMBLY for one call: chunks are concatenated / passed as one multi-part
prompt; output cached under the single (episode, version) key. Never one
call per chunk. Record in the bajan-0hs.3 implementation notes.

## Corrections from the review (incorporated above)

- CORR-002/EDGE-003: evidence spans are verbatim substrings, not
  necessarily sentence-aligned; containment gate is pure string ops; SBD
  is alignment aid only.
- EDGE-001 (HIGH): language coverage — UAX #29 is the language-neutral
  default; any abbreviation-table approach must declare locale bias.
- EDGE-002: short-episode dedup — simhash/entropy unreliable on very
  short texts; length-guard: below threshold use exact normalized-match.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every crate in the "inside bajan" table verified live: `cargo add --dry-run`,
  docs.rs existence, last-release recency, maintainer activity — pin exact
  versions in Cargo.toml (network was unavailable at investigation time).
- Chosen simhash crate passes a smoke test: near-duplicate pair (small edit
  distance) vs unrelated pair, simhash distance ordering as expected.
- Property-test generators extended per review: p_no_llm_post generators
  include short episodes, non-English (e.g. Spanish/German) episodes;
  evidence-span tests include whole-episode spans (p_typed_gate /
  ex_evidence_containment when bajan-0hs.3 lands).
- `cargo build && cargo test && cargo clippy -- -D warnings` stay green.
- Regression: full test suite green at close.

## Anti-goals

- No format parsers (markdown/PDF/EPUB/HTML) as bajan dependencies.
- No fuzzy matching in the containment GATE (rapidfuzz allowed only in the
  advisory reflection flag pass, if ever).
- No embedding-based entity matching (explicitly deferred).
- No ML/model runtime dependencies.
